The '''HyperMatter Tower''' was an administrative tower located in the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]], a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] refinery on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The tower also contained the region's primary refinery, and during the [[Galactic War]], the corrupt politician [[Harmon Torvix]] seized control of the Black Hole using the tower as his base.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HyperMatter Tower was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
